logic_errors.title: Pending assault validation trusts a target priority that assault commands do not permit
logic_errors.details: The loader calls selectDefendingArmies(stack, battle.defenderId) for both field battles and settlement assaults. However, startSettlementAssault at warfare.ts:139-140 selects without target priority. A resealed pending assault can therefore omit a required garrison container by changing defenderId to a later included army.
reproduction: Start conquestCampaign(). Add valid scout armies at settlement.6: army.100 with 12 formations, army.200 with 4, and army.300 with 9. Use unique, sorted formation IDs and nextId above every serial; refreshAuthoredSight and save/load.
Issue declareWar, besiege with army.2, then endTurn. Preserve this pre-assault state. A normal assault selects army.100 and army.200: 16 formations, matching the siege preview.
On a separate copy, temporarily remove army.100, refresh sight, and issue the real assault command. Its pending battle contains army.200 and army.300: 13 formations.
Restore army.100 and refresh sight. deserializeGame(serializeGame(state)) correctly rejects this with 'Invalid save: battle omitted a defending army'.
Change only battle.defenderId to 'army.300', then reseal using serializeGame. deserializeGame now accepts the same noncanonical 13-formation assault. The equivalent version-16 save still rejects it.
logic_errors.verification: Executed an independent, in-memory reproduction. The rejection assertion failed with exit code 1 because the forged version-17 assault was accepted.
logic_errors.requested_change: Validate assaults using untargeted stable-ID selection, reserving defenderId priority for field battles. Add the resealed-assault regression without changing historical-16 validation or the twenty-formation tactical budget.

summary: The two prior findings are closed, but this backend review remains blocked by the independently reproduced pending-assault validation defect. Read the entire captured patch and verified its 74,691-byte size, textual postimages, binary fixture, and all 20 manifest SHA256s; rechecked all 20 unchanged at completion. Added-line security scans were clear. Narrow Vitest runs with maxWorkers=2 and no cache passed 152/152 tests across 15 files, covering frontage, movement parity, reserves, officers/cargo, combat and compatibility. Independent paid-development probes verified morale 85 + nominal 18 deploys at 100 and returns to 85 after immediate attacker withdrawal; entering 84, 82 and 40 also preserve their entering morale, with per-command save/load and exact archive replay. Current working-tree persistence supports fresh version-17 manual and auto origins, loaded-journal continuation, compressed export/import and replay. Historical-16 hashes 602413fe, 289c01b6 and 58a2012d remain exact; mixed 16-to-17 replay preserves its historical prefix. No repository files were created or modified. No full-suite, UI, campaign-performance or broad persistence signoff is claimed.
